papers.status: Main paper, relevant appendices and targeted implementation reviewed; reproducibility discrepancies documented
access_limitations: Appendices A–I (PDF pp.13–22) were inspected for skill definitions, data integrity, training and routing failures. Appendix G/Table 13 reports Temporal DUET alone at 82.59 SR/75.40 SPL, versus full SkillNav 82.59/76.50 in Table 8: most R2R improvement over ScaleVLN 79.23/69.96 already occurs after temporal-data fine-tuning. Appendix I.3 examines 17 failure cases, with the landmark expert optimal in 13 but correctly selected once. The authors' vocabulary-overlap analysis is not a proof against all leakage; they explicitly acknowledge HM3D scene overlap. No benchmark was executed. The inspected batch-routing issue and configuration differences limit reproduction confidence. Appendix Table 10, visually checked in the rendered PDF p.18 (saved as evidence/03/skillnav_table10.png), reports Region DUET SR 36.67 and SPL 43.02. Under standard identical-episode SPL, SPL cannot exceed SR; the discrepancy needs author clarification before that row is used. The audit does not identify its cause. A separate four-line toy dispatch example reproduces the last-expert-over-batch mechanism, but no SkillNav checkpoint or simulator was run.
